description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across various linguistic families, with the vertical axis listing categories—IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque—arranged in descending order of task count. The horizontal axis, labeled "# tasks," ranges from 0 to 80 with tick marks at intervals of 10. IE-Slavic has the highest number of tasks, approximately 80, followed by IE-Romance with around 48 tasks. IE-Germanic and Uralic each have more than 40 tasks, with IE-Germanic at about 45 and Uralic slightly below at around 20. IE-Baltic shows a sharp decline, with fewer than 15 tasks (approximately 17). IE-other has about 15 tasks, IE-Indic around 10, Semitic approximately 8, Turkic around 5, and Basque the smallest category with fewer than 5 tasks (approximately 4). The bars are sorted in descending order, with IE-Slavic at the top and Basque at the bottom, visually emphasizing a steep initial drop from IE-Slavic to IE-Baltic, followed by a more gradual decline among the remaining families.
